entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mercè Company i González is a Catalan writer in Spanish, Catalan and French languages. She is among the most prominent Catalan writers of fiction for children and young adults. She studied journalism and worked for several magazines and publishing companies. She has authored more than 170 books and her works have been presented on television, radio and theatrical stages. She has been recognized many times for her works in children's and youth literature.
